related_questions.question: How long does COVID vaccine protection last?

text_blocks.snippet: COVID-19 vaccine protection duration varies but is generally strongest for about six months. Updated vaccines, like the 2024-25 version, are recommended to maintain optimal protection. Immunity can wane over time as antibody levels decrease. The updated vaccines are formulated to target the currently circulating variants.

list.title: Initial Protection:
list.snippet: The initial protection from the COVID-19 vaccine, especially the updated versions, is strong and provides significant defense against severe illness, hospitalization, and death.

list.title: Waning Immunity:
list.snippet: Over time, the level of protection offered by the vaccine can decrease. This is due to the gradual decline in antibody levels in the body.

list.title: Updated Vaccines:
list.snippet: To address waning immunity, updated COVID-19 vaccines are developed to better match the circulating variants. Health experts recommend getting the latest version to maintain optimal protection.

list.title: Recommendations:
list.snippet: For most people, a single dose of the updated vaccine is recommended for this respiratory virus season. People who are immunocompromised or between 6 months and 4 years old may need more than one dose.

list.title: Indirect Protection:
list.snippet: In addition to protecting the individual, studies suggest that vaccines can also offer some level of indirect protection by reducing transmission and spread of the virus, according to a YouTube video from MedStoryMini.
